text: {"action": null, "answer": "Project Zenith is a new data analytics initiative launched on June 15th with a $500,000 budget for phase one, led by Sarah Tan. Initial findings suggest a 20% efficiency increase using AI algorithms, to be discussed on August 5th. The project has secured a strategic partnership with TechInnovate and is moving into the development phase under lead developer Omar Jensen. A major milestone was reached with a successfully tested secure file sharing prototype, with UI enhancements planned for October. The team has expanded with new members specializing in cybersecurity, cloud architecture, machine learning, and cloud computing. A $15,000 training budget has been approved for the coding team and project managers. Security protocols have been updated to include multi-factor authentication and encryption at rest, effective January next year."}
